description: When the predicted end time has passed before the burst ends, DCD is the last to clear, so the idle is DCD-determined and LBT_WAIT_TIMER gets lbt_wait_dcd_ms.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". At 2000: a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9 (C_PDU ID 1) with EOT 2, end 3000. The burst ends at 4000, after the predicted end, so DCD clears last and rule 2 gives 30000 ms (K-0070, K-0073). Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
